R/ VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP / VOT P R

A late Roman copper alloy Nummus of Constantine I. VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP / VOT P R reverse type depicting two Victories holding shield inscribed VOT P R over altar. Illegible mint. Probably a contemporary copy. Obverse description: Laureate and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: Illegible. Reverse description: Two Victories holding shield inscribed VOT P R over altar. Reverse inscription: VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP / VOT P R
